::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 29th [1875]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95322
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1169.qmd)

You will find the history of the [Melanesian Mission](organizations/other_30.qmd) kept up in the magazines [the Net](organizations/other_94.qmd) and [Mission Life](organizations/other_80.qmd).

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to ‘Miss Peterson/Cliff Cottage/The Lees/Folkestone’ and postmarked Winchester E SP 29 75.
